senses.gloss: आम्रे फलार्थे निर्मिते छायागन्धे अनुत्पद्यते। एवं धर्मे चर्यमाणे अर्थाद्योऽनृत्पद्यन्ते। --सा० 4 A mango tree bends low when it is loaded with fruits. It regales those who seek refuge in it and regales them even by offering them sweet fruits and fragrance. Similarly, the deity whom we worship bestows many benefits on the worshippers like us but also offers many other benefits.
